name: ai-fleas-agent-bootstrap
description: Restores trusted AI Fleas agent identity and gates first-time initialization by exact task ID.

interface.longDescription: Loads trusted task-ID bindings at session start and permits initialization only through a host-registered, prompt-bound transaction.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check this task's trusted AI Fleas bootstrap binding. If it is unbound, explain that this is expected for a task opened from Try now, do not claim the locally installed plugin is unavailable, and tell me to initialize a Personal Governor explicitly through the GPT Agents controller for an exact human profile.
